  "description": "- Develop and implement optimization strategies to improve sales performance and streamline campaign workflows.\n- Monitor campaign health on a daily and weekly basis - proactively flag errors, budget anomalies, or performance drops and escalate appropriately.\n- Collaborate with the Tech team to ensure smooth and timely launches of new campaigns, resolving system-level blockers as they arise.\n- Coordinate with the Business Development (BD) team to understand and translate customer requirements into campaign configurations.\n- Work closely with the Sales team to align campaign execution with revenue KPIs and sales targets.\n- Negotiate with advertisers to establish favorable campaign terms, supporting the Sales team with data-backed proposals.\n- Manage monthly reconciliations accurately and in compliance with internal financial processes.\n- Provide weekly and ad-hoc performance reports with actionable insights for continuous improvement.\n- Handle operational requests including budget increases, gross commission adjustments, publisher link setups, and ADV report extractions\n- Career path towards a leadership role.",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n3 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Đại Học trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\n* **Experience: 3-5** years in performance marketing, campaign operations, or digital advertising\n* **Tools:** Proficiency in Excel/Sheets; familiarity with affiliate or ad platforms is a plus.\n* **Skills:** stakeholder management, data analysis & reporting, campaign operations.\n* **Soft skills:** Detail-oriented, proactive, analytical thinking, problem solving, able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.\n* Good English\n* Team player with a positive attitude and a strong sense of integrity and responsibility."
